comment: Opportunity signals (Opportunity Identification, mv_opportunity_signals): one row per signal the CRM signal engine or news alerts raised on a client from May-2024 to Sep-2026 - FX_FLOW_VIA_OTHER_BANK, LOAN_SERVICE_TO_OTHER_BANK, DEPOSIT_SURPLUS, TRADE_CORRIDOR_GROWTH, SCF_ANCHOR_CANDIDATE, SLL_ELIGIBLE, FACILITY_MATURING_12M, PRODUCT_GAP_VS_PEERS, CAPEX_NEWS and MA_NEWS - derived from real behaviour (payments to other banks, deposit balances, trade corridors, maturities, peer gaps, news), with estimated annual revenue, confidence, lifecycle status (Open, In Pipeline, Dismissed), RM action and lag, the linked pipeline opportunity and precomputed flags. "Open opportunities" in Genie questions means open signals unless the user says pipeline. Converted to Pipeline % = signals with a linked opportunity / signals (D21). Grain: one row per opportunity signal.
